description: Lady Young Lookout offers one of the most spectacular views in Trinidad. Perched high in the hills above the city, this vantage point is a photographer's dream. This scenic viewpoint is located along the Lady Young Road, overlooking the eastern side of Port of Spain and the surrounding foothills of the Northern Range. Listed opening hours: 24 HOURS. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
